headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory behind Kazuma Okamoto's 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Chicago Cubs came from behind to defeat the Baltimore Orioles 9-7, with Pete Crow-Armstrong hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. The Detroit Tigers took down the Athletics 6-1, led by Spencer Torkelson's home run and 3 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies) and Brad Lord (Washington Nationals), who have been placed on the 15-day injured list. Owen Caissie (Miami Marlins) and John King (Miami Marlins) have also been sidelined due to injuries. The Cleveland Guardians, Boston Red Sox, and Minnesota Twins have each lost a pitcher to injury as well.

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Matt Seelinger to the New York Mets for cash, while the Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers in a separate trade. The Cleveland Guardians received RHP Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies, and the Washington Nationals acquired LHP Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Come from Behind to Defeat Orioles 9-7**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a thrilling 9-7 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with a strong performance from Pete Crow-Armstrong, who hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Athletics 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Athletics, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates with a final score of 3-0. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a strong team effort contributing to the 10-5 final score. Impact hitters for the Braves included Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin, while Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Lane Thomas and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the charge for the Royals. Sean Manaea was an impact pitcher for the Royals in the loss.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Philadelphia Phillies left-handed pitcher Tanner Banks has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire Right-Hander Matt Seelinger**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger, acquired from the Detroit Tigers in a trade for cash.
